title: Course – GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON (2026 course map, 2027 event page)
claims: The official course page states that the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON route is 42.195 km and is known for being the flattest of the Abbott World Marathon Majors.
The page says the route passes Berlin's sights with very little elevation gain and that there are 15 aid stations along the course.
The page lists water-only refreshment points at 5, 12, 17.5, 22.5, 27.5, 32.5, 34.5, 38 and 40 km.
The page lists water, fruit, tea and Maurten Drink Mix 160 at 9, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 36 km.
The page lists Maurten Gel 100 at 27.5 km.

The page says own refreshments can be delivered to 5, 9, 15, 20, 25, 30, 36 and 40 km, with containers handed in from 07:00 to 07:45 at the own-refreshment stand outside the fenced area Annemarie-Renger-Str. / Otto-von-Bismarck-Allee.
The page says containers must be marked with the runner's name, bib number and refreshment point and must not be made of glass.
The page says all drinks are served in cups and that own hydration systems can be refilled at every refreshment point, at the last water table.

The current 2026/2027 course page gives elevation as 'tba' and provides an interactive map and a start/finish-area PDF link; it does not link a GPX or KML file. A separate official 2025 GPX file is documented in route-berlin-gpx-2025.
The page states that the interactive map shows the routes and information for the 2026 BMW BERLIN-MARATHON and will be updated when the 2027 map is available.
